principles: run-batch.mjs is a committed reproducible script; evidence must not depend on any interactive session.
Every iteration ends in EXACTLY one identity-keyed ledger record (proof XOR stop); prose is never an outcome.
Append-only + identity-keyed ledger (iterationId=replay/<scale>/<index>) so M3 resume can reconcile by multiset.
Reuse M0 lib/instrument.mjs; read the frozen protocol.json for N + budget cap.
Fail loudly: recordless iteration -> nonzero exit; concurrent driver -> precondition_failed via lockfile.
drivers: H1 is exact (any N>=2 detects drift); H4 is cap-vs-stop accounting — both adjudicated by M4 from the ledger only.
The full scale is heavy (1M records/cycle ~42.7s); full N=3 is a budget decision.
proof-or-stop is the load-bearing discipline the campaign demonstrates.

options.name: append-only-proof-or-stop-ledger
pros: Identity-keyed -> M3 resume reconciles by multiset
Typed records -> M4 adjudicates H1/H4 mechanically
cons: Must carefully source digests from the generation side

options.name: freeform-logs
cons: Prose is never an outcome; M4 cannot adjudicate mechanically; violates the proof-or-stop contract

rationale: The whole point being demonstrated is proof-or-stop: every iteration yields a typed, identity-keyed, digest-bound record or an explicit stop. Free-form logs would make H1/H4 non-adjudicable and break M3 resume reconciliation.

preMortem.scenario: Digest sourced from the wrong side
preMortem.trigger: run-batch records a verifier stability boolean instead of the generation-side digest
preMortem.mitigation: source records/gold/manifest digests from the generate result / the run manifest.json, per plan section 6.2

preMortem.trigger: a verify throw is caught but no stop record is appended
preMortem.consequence: a missing record is hidden; proof-or-stop broken
preMortem.mitigation: wrap each iteration so a crash maps to a verify_crash stop; assert exactly one record per iterationId and exit nonzero otherwise
honor the frozen budget cap: a cycle exceeding it records a budget_cap stop rather than hanging; capture elapsed/rss honestly
